name: Dub Network Referral Bonus
object: The Dub Network Referral Bonus, an ongoing payout for Dub Partners who refer other partners into Dub's own affiliate network
audience: Existing Dub Partners and affiliates looking to earn more by growing the partner network itself
message: This video tells existing Dub Partners that referring other partners now pays an ongoing bonus, not just a one-time reward.

moments.what: a retro VHS-static texture resolves into a shelf of labeled floppy disks branded 'dub', each naming a recent launch (Commission Analytics, Dub MCP & Platform Logs) with this feature as 'Disk 5 of 5'
moments.copy: the newest disk in a numbered set of recent Dub launches: Network Referral Bonus

moments.what: a quick cut lands on a plain title card naming the feature

the real partner dashboard appears: a referred-partner count, a running earnings total, a referral link, a rewards panel explaining the bonus terms, and a table of referred partners with join dates and active programs
moments.copy: 7 referred partners, $3,234 in earnings so far, with reward terms (a cut of referred partners' fees, plus a bonus past $10,000 in referred bonus earnings) laid out in the panel

moments.what: the screen cuts to the Dub wordmark and then a short link

cta: Ends on the Dub logo cutting to the short link d.to/network-referral as the single next step to read the program's terms.
why: Opening on a shelf of numbered 'disks' for the week's other launches frames this as one of several features shipping together, which signals momentum rather than a lone minor tweak. Showing the real referral dashboard with a specific partner count and dollar figure, not a mockup, makes the bonus feel like it is already paying out, which is what earns the short-link close.
